what: head-rebuild study: the RefCOCO-family candidate-restriction stage re-measured from our own mechanisms as deterministic re-analysis over cached records (SAM ViT-H pool + cached G2L masked-region features + cached VLM boxes; no vision re-generation)
attribution_note: Both drop-one directions, measured on the full official val splits (the reference arm reproduces the shipped released-score head bit-exactly, delta 0.0000): given the box, the released restriction is worth -1.45 / -0.56 / +0.29 mIoU; given the restriction, the box is worth +25.21 / +26.82 / +17.61 mIoU. Under the shipped iou box-fill and sentence box the restriction is ~neutral given the box; the quoted directive figures (box-over-full-pool 50.20/40.24/49.48) could not be reproduced under any tested configuration -- iou/cover/inside modes, sentence/noun phrase, LLaVA boxes (exp159b_boxsource_probe.json) -- and are recorded as unreconciled; the box carries the conjunction either way. Shape note (reviewer hypothesis, recorded): the quoted triple's ordering (highest refcoco, lowest refcocoplus, refcocog between) matches the released-scores-only arm (43.33/37.85/47.51), suggesting the quoted figure may have originated from a different arm/iteration or an older box cache rather than the shipped configuration.

verdict: PROMOTE: the ours-only arm 'learned_head' holds parity or better with the released-score head on all three full official val splits (mean 67.49 vs reference 66.11; deltas refcoco +2.03, refcocoplus +1.69, refcocog +0.43), so the candidate-restriction stage no longer depends on the released scores and the shipped head's decisive scoring components are all ours. Caveat disclosed in the paper: this head reads the cached masked-region features (released G2L extractor) through our full-sentence text protocol; the arms that use neither released scores, released features nor text (learned_geom/learned_geom2) reach 64.58 on refcocog, 0.5 below the head they would replace, so the feature path is retained as the declared platform.
